text: Two beams can form a stable interference pattern only if they share the same frequency, the same polarization, and a stable relative phase. This overall property of a light field is called ___.
explanation: Coherence is the property that permits sustained interference; temporal coherence sets the usable bandwidth and spatial coherence sets the beam's transverse phase correlation. A laser is highly coherent, whereas a thermal source (lamp, LED) is largely incoherent.
